eval.title: Copper Investing Strategy & FCX Stock Analysis

call.headline_quote: so we can say that now compared to others freeport is fairly priced

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: let's say they make 5 billion in operating cash flows on an average year spent 2 billion on capex half a billion on that half a billion on taxes and other i get to free cash flows of 2 billion per year

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: 2 billion per year on a market capitalization of 25 billion i have to correct it here gives me a free cash flow yield of eight percent

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: if copper goes to 3.5 i assume a double in the stock we would reach 50 billion in market capitalization

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if things get bad assume 50 down at least

what_is_priced_in.quote: on a long-term historical perspective the stock is where it was in the 1990s still now and cheap compared to exuberant times

reasons.claim: At current copper prices FCX generates an 8% free cash flow yield on its market cap, which he considers reasonably attractive given upside if copper rallies.
reasons.quote: 2 billion per year on a market capitalization of 25 billion i have to correct it here gives me a free cash flow yield of eight percent

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.08, as-of -0.067878 (FY2019); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Copper and copper stocks are highly cyclical, with FCX doubling or falling 50-70% depending on the copper price cycle, so entry timing matters.
reasons.quote: the upside is 100 if not if there is a crisis the downside is 50 to 70

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: upside, downside

reasons.claim: FCX is a diversified, large, low-cost producer with gold by-products (notably at Grasberg) lowering effective copper production costs.
reasons.quote: grasper produces copper at zero cost if you take the gold by products into account

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: average production cost

reasons.claim: FCX carries meaningful debt and interest costs that become a problem if copper prices fall, and its Indonesian mine ownership share is set to drop.
reasons.quote: they own 81 of economic benefits through 2022 and then just 50 plus they need to build the smelter

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: interest expense

reasons.claim: Copper demand growth depends heavily on China (51% of global demand) transitioning away from infrastructure-heavy growth, which caps upside.
reasons.quote: china creates 51 percent of global copper demand because most of copper is used for infrastructure and construction

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: china share of copper demand

external_facts_used: Wind farm requires 4.7 tons of copper; EV needs ~109kg vs normal car
Middle class growth projections of 1.5-2 billion people over next decades
Top six producers' supply growth estimated at 2.8 million tons (13% of current supply)
Copper cost curve: 90% of production costs around $2/lb
Freeport's ownership stake in Grasberg mine (Indonesia) set to change from 81% to 50%+ after 2022
Comparison to peer copper miners' valuations (Southern Copper, KAZ Minerals, Boliden, Hudbay, Antofagasta)

critic.notes: Borderline: he calls FCX fairly priced vs peers, but as an absolute investor he only checks it at 10-12B market cap (~50% lower) and keeps watching; 'only interesting much lower' reads as avoid rather than fair_hold.
